_doc: The House Cup (docs/architecture.md): weekly from week_start (UTC, no daylight saving), raw sums of house_points per house, ties shared. Per-player daily caps per source, in points, per UTC day: class (the class's own 1 / 3 / 5 tiers), duel (dueling's own cap: win_house_points x house_point_wins_daily in data/dueling/rules.json, which must equal it), find (points per find that turned something up), craft (points per craft of a recipe of skill min_skill or more), npc (points per house ghost's daily gift, docs/architecture.md 'NPCs'). The week's winners mail the reward item to every character of a winning house with at least reward.min_points that week, and wear the cup badge the following week. Mail text is our own; {house} is the winning house's display name.

mail.subject: The House Cup is {house}'s this week
mail.body: Congratulations. {house} won the House Cup last week, and you helped: your points went into the hourglass. Please accept this pennant for your room, with the staff's compliments. Your house's banners hang in the Great Hall all this week.
